headline: The attract demo finally shows all five skills
lede: LEMMINGS-LITE's demo replays the solver's proven script — and the solver never needs floaters — so no parachute ever opened on screen. The demo now spends its own float charges showing the fifth skill: canopies catch the crowd, THE DOOR opens one mid-air at the step-off, and the solver's win line is untouched.

notes.text: attract.js exports a pure demoFloatPick: unsripted airborne lemmings get the canopy first, else the first unsripted walker after a 5 s grace rides it (auto-open law deploys it on their next fall). Two canopies per cycle, never over the pond, never a script target — a rescue can only add exits, never steal one.

lemcheck 177/177 and --mutate 199/199 with 20 new pins; red-proof x3 by hand (target exclusion, grace, water skip). Live Chrome: deploy at tick 311, striped canopy painted in 16+8 px, SPIRE still clears at tick 1984 of 7200, zero page errors.

BUILDER sized against the solver (posted on #3853): placed-cell planks mean grid-state in solve()'s search space plus a full re-prove of all four levels — the first gap that legitimately needs a multi-session WIP branch. Cheaper alternates left on the shelf: more ponds, waking blockers.

Prod verification lesson: CI bundle hashes don't match local builds — verify what the player sees instead (canopy-red pixels in THE SPIRE's attract window are the pre/post fingerprint, zero before the fix).

look.text: LEMMINGS-LITE attract now deploys parachutes on screen
